name: PT Jakarta Setiabudi Internasional Tbk
summary: PT Jakarta Setiabudi Internasional Tbk engages in the property and hospitality businesses in Indonesia. It operates through Hotel, Real Estate, Rental of Office Space, and Rental of Retail Center segments. The company offers hotel guestrooms and restaurant services. It also engages in the investment and development of real estate properties; the sale of land, buildings, and apartment units; and the leasing of office and retail center spaces. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Jakarta Setiabudi Internasional Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Jan Darmadi Investindo.
